researchProtocol: For the research condition, run the same prompt through /api/research first and provide only ideationContext to the skill. Record the research run ID and preserve cited URLs for validation.

cases.prompt: Generate 5 startup ideas that make coordinating care for an aging parent less exhausting for siblings who live in different cities. Identify the market gap behind each idea.
Invent practical ways for renters in old apartment buildings to stay cool during heat waves without installing central air.
Propose 4 software tools that reduce the cost of too many internal meetings without simply transcribing or summarizing them. Explain what current tools still fail to solve.
Create consumer product ideas that reduce edible food waste in a two-person household.
Suggest testable, resource-conscious research concepts for detecting microplastic accumulation in urban soil.
Design differentiated features for a language-learning product used during a daily commute.
Develop 6 unusual but feasible business models that make small-appliance repair financially attractive again. Consider why existing repair options remain expensive or inconvenient.

Find 5 product opportunities for small field-service companies that already use scheduling and invoicing software but still rely on spreadsheets, text messages, or paper. Separate invention opportunities from market-gap opportunities.

Generate 4 business or product ideas for people with limited hand dexterity who struggle with smart-home hardware and setup. Existing products are allowed; focus on what they solve badly and preserve the requested count.
